question: What is the meaning of building energy label in relation to building infromation?
description: The building energy label refers to a certification or rating system that evaluates and communicates the energy efficiency of a building. It is part of the broader concept of building information, which encompasses data about the materials, construction processes, and overall performance of a building. The energy label typically includes information on energy consumption, cost savings, and environmental impact, helping stakeholders make informed decisions about building design, construction, and operation.
